doc.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2024 [interview 2 of 2]

title: A lesson video: put both feet on the floor
summary: Rowe recalls a lesson video where McPherson told a tenor player to plant his feet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Well I watched an Aha! moment, one of your lessons with a saxophone player is on a video, and I just got a kick out of this because he played something and then you said something that’s so basic that most people wouldn’t bother. And you told him to put both his feet on the floor.
What was he playing? Was he playing saxophone?
And he had one of the iRealPro things on the screen I think. But I think he was sitting but your point was you’re not rooted to the ground here.
You know and it’s a very basic thing and I was pleased to hear you just point that out and the look on his face was like oh, okay.
